Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) drive innovation, create jobs and fuel economic growth. In the latest ‘ERGO Talk’, Chief Underwriting Officer Edward Ler of the ERGO Group talks to Effi Fuks-Leichtag, Chief Product Officer at ERGO NEXT Insurance, about the future of SMEs and their specific insurance needs.
The discussion focuses on the strategic importance of this segment for ERGO, the differences between the markets in Europe, Asia and the US, and the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in driving further growth in the SME segment.
Find out more in the video.
